verified: A Financial Times analysis by Rafe Rosner-Uddin reports that Ohio voters backed ballot measures to stall data-center development, putting more than $17bn of Amazon's planned Ohio AI data-center investment at risk and affecting three proposed projects; the FT's own headline and standfirst frame this as part of wider local backlash against Big Tech expansion.
unconfirmed: Amazon's response, the precise investment figure, which three projects are affected and whether they are delayed or cancelled, the vote margins and exact terms of the measures — none of this detail appears in the headline-level material available, and the item is a Techmeme re-report of the FT analysis rather than a primary company or regulatory filing.

verified: 据《金融时报》记者 Rafe Rosner-Uddin 的这篇分析报道，俄亥俄州选民通过了意在延缓数据中心开发的措施，亚马逊在该州逾 170 亿美元的 AI 数据中心投资因此面临风险，涉及三个拟建项目；FT 官网该文摘要同样表述为“逾 170 亿美元”。
unconfirmed: 亚马逊是否确认投资规模、是否会取消或只是推迟项目，以及受影响的三个项目具体是哪几个、公投措施的具体条款与通过票数比例，现有来源均未给出；报道亦未说明该投资数字是已签约金额还是长期规划总额。“全美范围选民反弹威胁数十亿美元 AI 投资”属 FT 的分析性判断，而非独立核实的事实。

titles.en: Amazon's $17B+ Ohio data-center plans at risk after midterm vote
titles.zh: 亚马逊俄亥俄州170亿美元以上数据中心投资面临风险
